measures: the first replay of E15 on a lineage other than the author's, under a separate operator, with isolation declared. It CONTRADICTS the rule this experiment produced (S12).
scale: 24 scored points per archive (one pass, 15 calls)

contradicts.rule: S12 (norm 0.4): a declaration handed on for reuse SHOULD carry worked cases the receiver can run, because cases were measured to stop a false rule from being copied on
contradicts.what_this_run_shows: on this model the eight refuting cases stop nothing: 24 of 24 copied, where both Claude models kept the rule 24 of 24. The explicit instruction to check the archive — which changed no point on either Claude model — is the only thing that moves this one, and only to 8 of 24.
contradicts.consequence: S12's measured protection is lineage-dependent. Carrying cases is sufficient for the anthropic/claude lineage measured here; it is not sufficient in general.
two_readings_one_pass_cannot_separate: capability: a Flash-tier model may not run the cases against the recipe unless it is told to. S12 would then be a claim about how much a model checks on its own, not about archives.
authority: some lineages give the recipe authority over the cases as well as over the reasons. Then E15's third row generalises and its fourth does not.
contradicts.what_would_separate_them: a DeepSeek run that is not Flash-tier, or any second Flash-tier model from another family
